source.title: Astoundingly Awesome Tales Issue #3 — Showdown in Skull Canyon
source.pagination: PDF/source pages 1–3 are unnumbered front matter; PDF/source pages 4–23 match printed pages 4–23.

authority.rule: Use collection mechanical differences only when already approved in the project; otherwise record the divergence without silently normalizing.

method: PDF source -> expected inventory -> repository -> canonical -> EN -> FR -> tests

pageReview.notes: Cover only.
Credits and legal text only.
Contents only.
Adventure synopsis only.
Adventure hooks and quest-level guidance only.
Encounter prose; .44 Pistol and Assault Rifle are references to existing identities, not complete profiles.
Narrative NPCs and vendor setup; Strobe Beacon is named but lacks reusable mechanics.
Complete Wastelander profile. It differs from the Core identity and from the later collection profile, so it is retained as a distinct Issue #3 variant.
Biogel and Epoxy are fully structured consumables already present from earlier remediation; verified against the individual issue.
Eight Issue #3 consumables verified; six Core consumables are identical reprints using existing identities.
Meeting Xarn is narrative scenario material; no complete reusable profile.

Complete Twinjaw Rattler profile. Existing Issue #3 identity verified. Structured butchery points to the p.10 Mutant Rattler Meat identity under the previously approved project normalization while retaining the individual issue's fang/poison-sack branches.

Named Ranger personalities plus optional tactical modifiers to the NCR Trooper baseline. These are scenario-specific optional modifications, not autonomous complete reusable profiles; no separate Actor identities created.
Complete NCR Trooper profile. Existing Issue #3 identity retained; embedded attack Items were corrected so their executable attribute/skill pairs match the printed STR/AGI + skill tests.
NCR information and investigation clues only; Brown and Aurelius are narrative references without autonomous complete profiles on this page.

Uncovering the Secret is investigation and location prose. The homing beacon, alien tool, papers and power-cell factory are not given complete reusable profiles; no new canonical/EN/FR document is warranted.

Aliens Unveiled and Decisions, Decisions provide narrative NPC reactions and hospital/technology descriptions only. Vexx, Zara’el, Xarn, Sally Jessup and Sarah Miller do not receive complete reusable profiles on this page.
Act Two synopsis only; it previews conflicts, NPCs and a Zetan laboratory but defines no autonomous reusable structured document.

Awash with Conflict reuses the already-certified Twinjaw Rattler encounter identity from p.12 plus previously established NCR/Wastelander references; no new stat block, embedded Item, salvage or butchery data appears, so no duplicate identity or provenance change is created.

The Lone Wolf and Investigating the Rangers’ Motivation are scenario prose. Corporal Brown has no complete reusable profile; the security drones are encounter references whose complete profile first appears on p.21.

Complete Security Drone, Protectron profile. The existing Issue #3 identity is retained and corrected to the individual issue: Energy DR 4 (All), BODY + Guns for Arm Lasers, robot origin/body type, and structured robot salvage (2 DC common materials, +1 DC per AP spent, each Effect yielding 1 uncommon material).

Complete Super Mutant profile. Its Issue #3 inventory includes Super Mutant Helmet and Super Mutant Leg Guards x2, so it is not an identical reprint of the Core Super Mutant. A distinct Issue #3 identity is used. The later collection replaces this profile with a mechanically different Abomination; that change is not applied to the 2023 source identity.
Secret Manipulation is scenario narrative. Private Mark Aurelius is referenced but receives no autonomous complete reusable profile on this page.
Act Three synopsis and Choosing Sides are scenario narrative only; no autonomous reusable structured document is defined.

The Battle of Skull Canyon and Encounter 3A define an Extended Test and encounter composition. They reference existing NCR, Protectron and Twinjaw identities, while the Inertia Suppression Field is only named here and receives its complete reusable profile on p.26.

Complete Skull Canyon Zetan Actor and Inertia Suppression Field apparel profile. The existing Actor is corrected to the 2023 issue: Mutated Reptile, 45 XP, BODY + Guns for all three attacks, explicit inventory text, and no salvage/butchery. The apparel identity is retained, its bilingual coverage completed, and its collection appearance corrected to printed p.66.

Final-confrontation scenario procedure and reinforcement guidance only. The individual issue gives no autonomous Sally profile and refers to alien abominations 'see p.26' even though p.26 contains no abomination stat block; no new identity is inferred from that internal inconsistency.

candidates.name: Wastelander (AAT #3)
candidates.note: Individual p.8 prints Carry Weight 200 lb, Melee Weapons 2 and Energy Weapons 1, and omits ammunition from Inventory. A distinct identity prevents collapsing it into the Core Wastelander.

candidates.name: Epoxy
candidates.note: Individual issue: Repair difficulty -1. Collection p.51 adds a minimum of 0; no prior project approval for that correction was located in this lot.

candidates.name: Skull Canyon Shot
candidates.note: Individual issue grants +3 Radiation DR, Lasting. Collection p.52 omits Lasting; no prior project approval for that change was located in this lot.

candidates.name: Twinjaw Rattler
candidates.note: First structured appearance is Issue #3 p.12. Butchery is structured with 2 DC Mutant Rattler Meat via the existing p.10 identity, 2 common materials, fang on an Effect, and the individual issue's poison-sack branch on two Effects.

candidates.name: NCR Trooper
candidates.note: First structured appearance is Issue #3 p.14. Canonical profile retains LUC 4 and the individual issue inventory; embedded attacks now execute with the printed STR/AGI + skill pairings.

candidates.name: Security Drone, Protectron
candidates.note: First structured appearance is Issue #3 p.21. Corrected to Energy DR 4 (All), BODY + Guns Arm Lasers, robot body type/origin, and structured salvage: difficulty 1, 2 DC common materials with +1 DC per AP spent, each Effect yielding 1 uncommon material.

candidates.name: Super Mutant (AAT #3)
candidates.note: Issue #3 p.22 has the Core-like level-5 profile but adds Super Mutant Helmet and Super Mutant Leg Guards x2 to Inventory. The printed table shows Radiation/Poison DR 0 while its explicit abilities grant immunity; canonical structured resistance therefore records Immune. Kept distinct from the Core Super Mutant and from the collection-only Abomination.

candidates.name: Skull Canyon Zetan
candidates.note: Issue #3 p.26 is the first complete profile. Retains the individual issue's Mutated Reptile classification and 45 XP; all embedded attacks use BODY + Guns, inventory is explicit, and no salvage/butchery is present. The 2024 collection changes the classification to Mutated Alien and XP to 38, so it is not recorded as an identical appearance without project approval.

candidates.name: Inertia Suppression Field
candidates.note: Complete p.26 armor/shield profile: Physical 3, Energy 3, Radiation 0, all locations, weight <1, cost 300, rarity 4. Existing identity retained; missing FR overlay added and the identical 2024 collection appearance corrected to printed p.66.

collectionReview.mapping: Individual printed/source pages 4–19 correspond to collection printed pages 46–61. From source p.20 onward the collection reflows and rewrites this section, so pp.20–23 are compared by heading/stat block rather than by a fixed page offset.

verifiedDifferences.difference: The observation test changes from PER + Speech to INT + Speech; narrative-only for compendium scope.
Wastelander changes to Carry Weight 210 lb, Melee Weapons 1, removes Energy Weapons 1, and adds 3+3 DC Shotgun Shells to Inventory.
Epoxy adds '(to a minimum of 0)' to the Repair difficulty reduction.
Skull Canyon Shot omits the individual issue's Lasting keyword.
Living “mutant” worm rewords the AP benefit as 'Immediately gain 1 AP'; treated as wording-only in this checkpoint.

Butchery changes the yield name from 'Twinjaw Rattler meat' to 'Mutant Rattler meat'. The project had already approved reuse of the p.10 Mutant Rattler Meat identity for the structured yield, so that normalization remains applied.

Twin Heads is expanded to tie the two bites to a Major attack action and explicitly allow different targets; Death Rattle changes to once per battle and grants Stun to all attacks until end of turn; the poison-sack butchery branch is removed. These collection changes were not found as previously approved project corrections, so the individual-issue mechanics remain canonical.
The collection adds a Core p.337 cross-reference for making Sergeant Jackson Notable; the optional named-Ranger modifiers remain scenario guidance rather than autonomous complete profiles.

The collection changes the NCR Trooper's LUC from 4 to 3 and adds 12+4 DC 10mm Rounds to Inventory. No prior project approval for those mechanical changes was located; the individual 2023 profile is retained.
Negotiation procedure and NCR-information prose are revised in the collection, but these are scenario procedures rather than reusable compendium documents.

The collection changes Homing Beacon discovery from a critical success to any AP spent during the investigation, changes the factory snooping test from AGI + Sneak to PER + Sneak, and adds a future-quest hook. These are scenario procedures/prose, not reusable compendium documents, so they are documented but not applied.

The collection makes Vexx truthful only if the PCs previously earned his trust (otherwise wary), adjusts Xarn/editorial wording, and revises hospital read-aloud prose. No complete reusable profile is defined, so no repository normalization is applied.

The collection revises the failed snake-warning result from 'surprised' to 'unaware' and explicitly points to the Core Rulebook Sneak Attack rule; this is encounter procedure only. The existing p.12 Twinjaw Rattler identity and butchery remain unchanged.

The collection clarifies the infiltration alternatives (including difficulty 4 for the Repair route), success wording, and the duration of recurring security-drone waves. These are scenario procedures rather than reusable compendium documents.

Security Drone, Protectron changes Energy DR from 4 (All) in the individual 2023 issue to 3 (All) in the 2024 collection. No prior project approval for this mechanical correction was found, so the individual issue's Energy DR 4 remains canonical for the Issue #3 identity and the collection is not marked as an identical appearance.

The collection replaces the individual issue's fully armed Super Mutant profile with an Abomination profile that keeps the same base SPECIAL/skills but only the Unarmed Strike attack and a different inventory (Board, Scrapped and Damaged Armor, assorted human bones, Wealth 1). No prior project approval was found, so the Issue #3 Super Mutant remains a distinct 2023 variant and the existing collection Abomination remains a separate identity.
Secret Manipulation is reflowed into collection p.64 without defining a reusable profile for Mark Aurelius; no compendium normalization is applied.

The collection makes minor narrative/editorial fixes in the Act Three synopsis and Choosing Sides (including explicit Legion alignment wording and typo cleanup). No reusable structured document is affected.

The collection changes the Extended Test scaling: Breakthroughs Required stays 4 while Base Test Difficulty becomes 3 for more than four PCs, rather than increasing required breakthroughs to 5. It also rewrites the reinforcement basis and identifies Nok as a Major Skull Canyon Zetan NPC. These are scenario procedures/modifiers, not autonomous reusable profiles.

Skull Canyon Zetan changes from Mutated Reptile, Normal Creature (45 XP) in the 2023 issue to Mutated Alien, Normal Creature (38 XP) in the 2024 collection; the collection also adds that Xarn and Nok are Mighty Creatures with +2 Mind. No prior project approval for these mechanical changes was found, so the 2023 profile remains canonical and the collection is not marked identical for this Actor.

Inertia Suppression Field retains the same 3 Physical / 3 Energy / 0 Radiation resistances, all locations, weight <1, cost 300 and rarity 4. Its collected-edition appearance is an identical reprint for the apparel identity.

The collection replaces the individual issue's round/excess-attempt reinforcement wording with breakthrough-count tables and adds a concrete Sally Jessup profile based on the Core Mercenary stat block (+2 STR/END/AGI, HP 18, Defense 2, 90 XP). No prior project approval for these collection-only mechanical additions was found, so they are not integrated into the 2023 source inventory.

openArbitrations: Epoxy: the collected edition p.51 adds a minimum-0 floor to the Repair difficulty reduction; this difference is verified but was not found as a previously approved project correction.
Skull Canyon Shot: the collected edition p.52 removes Lasting from the +3 Radiation damage resistance; this difference is verified but was not found as a previously approved project correction.

Twinjaw Rattler: collection p.54 expands Twin Heads, changes Death Rattle timing/scope, and removes the individual issue's poison-sack butchery branch. No prior project approval was found for those changes; Issue #3 p.12 remains canonical for them.
NCR Trooper: collection p.56 changes LUC 4 to 3 and adds 12+4 DC 10mm Rounds to Inventory. No prior project approval was found; Issue #3 p.14 remains canonical.

Security Drone, Protectron: collection p.63 changes Energy DR from the individual issue's 4 (All) to 3 (All). No prior project approval was found, so Issue #3 p.21 remains canonical at Energy DR 4 and the collection is not classified as an identical appearance.

Super Mutant / Abomination: collection p.62 replaces the individual Issue #3 p.22 Super Mutant profile with a mechanically different Abomination and different inventory. No prior project approval was found; the 2023 Super Mutant is retained as its own AAT #3 variant and the collection Abomination remains separate.

Skull Canyon Zetan: collection p.66 changes the individual Issue #3 p.26 classification from Mutated Reptile to Mutated Alien and XP from 45 to 38, and adds Mighty/+2 Mind guidance for Xarn and Nok. No prior project approval was found; the 2023 profile remains canonical and the collection is not classified as an identical Actor appearance.

Final confrontation: collection p.67 rewrites reinforcement scaling around breakthroughs and adds a Mercenary-based Sally Jessup profile (+2 STR/END/AGI, HP 18, Defense 2, 90 XP). These collection-only mechanics have no located prior approval and are not applied to the 2023 source lot.
